description: Announced, still-upcoming milestones with target dates across all tracked companies, soonest first. This is the forward-looking view: what each company has committed to next and by when, with the source for the commitment and that company's track record on past announcements. Filter by company or industry.

includeUndated.description: Include milestones whose target has no parseable time signal ("Ongoing"). They sort last.

name: list_upcoming_milestones
